name: Unstage the .codx/tmp probe scratch file before the next commit (CISO warn — clean content, wrong place)
description:
CISO shift 2026-11-20T13:2xZ found a `.codx` control-plane scratch file sitting in the **git index** of the root repo `codx-junior-platform`, ready to be committed.

## Finding (content clean, provenance wrong)
`api/.codx/tmp/pm-capability-probe.txt` — status `A`, +3 lines (`probe line 1` / `probe line 2` / `probe line 3`). It is the scratch file written by the capability probe (card 20821135) that was supposed to be deleted afterwards. The file is already gone from disk (`project_read_file` → `File not found`), so it exists **only in the index**: the next `git commit` writes it into history permanently.

`security_review_changes(scope="staged")` → `allow`, 0 findings, so there is **no secret and no code** in it. Do not treat this as a leak; the action is unstaging, not rotation.

## Do
1. `git restore --staged api/.codx/tmp/pm-capability-probe.txt` (agents have no delete tool — this needs a human/`devops` shell).
2. Confirm it is gone from the index: `git diff --cached --name-only` must not print it.
3. Verify `.codx/tmp/` cannot be staged again (check the ignore rules of the root repo; today `.codx` control-plane data is tracked at all — see card `39a2d6a4`).
4. Do **not** `git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean` the working tree: it holds 166 changed files that other cards depend on.

## Acceptance
- `git diff --cached --name-only` no longer lists any `.codx/tmp/` path, and the probe file does not appear in the next commit.
- One line in the completion comment: the exact command run and its output.

Do not run the atlas/discovery tools on this repo while `d8534b12` is open — they hang for 120 s.
